title: Use parameterized queries for every database access
description: Never build a SQL statement by concatenating untrusted input into the query text. Always use a parameterized/prepared-statement API so the database driver binds values separately from the query's structure.

title: Enforce object ownership at the query level, not after the fact
description: Scope every lookup of a user-owned resource by the authenticated user's identity inside the query itself (e.g. WHERE id = ? AND owner_id = ?), so a guessed or enumerated identifier alone can never return another user's data.

title: Isolate untrusted retrieved content from system instructions
description: Never concatenate retrieved/untrusted content directly into the system prompt. Pass it as user-turn data in its own message, and instruct the model explicitly to treat it as data, never as instructions, even if it tries to override that rule.

title: Rate-limit LLM calls per client to bound cost and denial-of-wallet risk
description: Apply a per-user or per-IP rate limit (token bucket or leaky bucket) in front of every LLM-backed endpoint, so a single client cannot drive unbounded compute cost or exhaust shared capacity.

title: Pin exact dependency versions and verify them with a lockfile/hash
description: Never resolve dependencies via an open version range or an unpinned "latest" tag. Pin an exact, reviewed version and verify it against a lockfile hash (go.sum, requirements.txt --require-hashes, sbt lock, etc.) so a build never silently pulls a different, potentially compromised release.
